text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly making no trades as the account fell showed me that holding is still a decision; I should reassess the portfolio each period instead of letting discomfort keep me passive.","Selling Stock A for gains and later buying it back taught me that a realized profit is not a reason by itself to sell, nor is a lower price by itself a reason to repurchase.","I should size and diversify positions with my risk tolerance in mind, and make changes according to a consistent plan rather than reacting to the satisfaction or pain of gains and losses."]}
